name: Stormbringer: Thunder King's critical strikes hit back and stack Raging Storm (#3410)
contract: #3410: Thunder King 804591 reads 'For $d, your Call Lightning / Torrential Wrath strikes $s3 additional nearby enemies, your movement speed is increased by $800046s1%, and you generate 5 Static every $t2 sec. While active, damaging critical strikes deal bonus Spellstorm Damage scaling with your spell power, and grant Raging Storm.' Spell.dbc gives 804591 DurationIndex 18 (SpellDuration.dbc 18 = 20000 ms) and RecoveryTime 180000. Three clauses are native and are asserted as a baseline: effect 2 is aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER with EffectMiscValue 17 (SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS, SpellDefines.h:93), EffectBasePoints 2 and DieSides 1, so the modifier is 3 and its class mask word 1 = 17 selects Call Lightning (SpellFamilyFlags word 1 = 16) and Torrential Wrath (word 1 = 1); data/sql/updates/pending_db_world/rev_1789379311228000700.sql links 800046 to it as SPELL_LINK_AURA, and 800046 is aura 31 MOD_INCREASE_SPEED with BasePoints 24 and DieSides 1 (the tooltip's 25%); effect 1 triggers 804044 every 1000 ms, whose effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_AURA_STACKS with EffectMiscValue 5 on Static 803102, handled at SpellEffects.cpp:444. The last two clauses had no path: effect 0's SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL on Thunder Fist 800020 has ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skips it (SpellMgr.cpp:2256-2257), and nothing in the whole Spell.dbc, in any SQL row or in any module line references Raging Storm 800014 (aura 216 HASTE_SPELLS, BasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = 3%, StackAmount 10). The fix casts 800020 on the victim and 800014 on the Stormbringer on every non-triggered critical hit while Thunder King is up. Call Lightning is cast as rank 501398, the rank a level-80 character owns (AscensionSpellProgressionData.h:574 gives it RequiredLevel 79), and spell_crit_rating 100000 makes the critical strike deterministic. The spell-power coefficient of Thunder Fist is a separate spell_bonus_data question and is deliberately not part of this scenario.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
BASELINE: Call Lightning has no extra chain targets without Thunder King
BASELINE: no movement speed companion aura
BASELINE: Thunder Fist has never been cast
NATIVE: SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS adds 3 to Call Lightning (BasePoints 2 + DieSides 1)
NATIVE: the linked movement speed aura 800046 is applied
Static stacks before three periodic ticks
NATIVE: 5 Static per second (804044 effect 1, EffectMiscValue 5)
SETUP: Call Lightning lands as a critical strike
DISCRIMINATING: the critical strike casts Thunder Fist (800020)
DISCRIMINATING: the critical strike grants one Raging Storm stack (800014, cap 10)
